# Roles and grants

The variable widens the description only. It is an <!-- want "repetition.exact-sentence" -->
environment variable rather than a flag because `ptah-compat` registers exactly
the flags the Atlas community CLI registers.

The variable changes only whether Ptah refuses first or the server does. It is
an environment variable rather than a flag because `ptah-compat`
registers exactly the flags the Atlas community CLI registers.

The client reads the value from `LEFT` before sending the request to the configured server.

The client reads the value from `RIGHT` before sending the request to the configured server.
